item.title: NATO launches Operation Arctic Sentry to boost Arctic security
item.description: NATO has launched “Arctic Sentry” to enhance Arctic security through exercises and surveillance. Supported by the U.S., NATO will now coordinate military presence across the entire region. item.title: Flu hospitalizations and RSV cases are rising
item.description: According to the weekly update from Statens Serum Institut (SSI), both influenza cases and hospitalizations continue to rise in Denmark. item.title: Danske Bank to offer cryptocurrency investment products
item.description: Danske Bank is changing course on cryptocurrency. After years in which major Danish banks warned customers against digital currencies, the country’s largest lender will now allow indirect investment in bitcoin and ethereum. In a press release, the bank said it will offer access through exchange-traded products known as ETPs. These products give exposure to cryptocurrencies […]

item.title: Convicted killer has been at large for a week
item.description: One week after 37-year-old convicted murderer Philip Denié Dahl Petersen escaped from Vestre Fængsel by climbing over a wall, he remains at large. Copenhagen Police report that the manhunt is still highly active, and they have received numerous tips from the public. Petersen was sentenced to safe custody for a 2022 murder committed in Copenhagen’s […]

item.title: We got into one of Denmark’s deportation center
item.description: Erasmus Mundus journalism student Huadan Huang was allowed to enter Kærshovedgård deportation center (technically a “departure centre”) with a volunteer organization, where foreigners stay before being expelled from a country. This is what she found out in an article she wrote for The Copenhagen Post.

item.description: Influenza cases and hospitalizations continue to rise, with nearly 3,000 cases and 1,000 hospitalizations recorded in week 6. item.title: Snow may delay mail delivery
item.description: Heavy snowfall and an approaching blizzard, particularly in southern Denmark, may delay mail delivery, warns distribution company Dansk Avis Omdeling (Dao). item.title: Copenhagen apartment prices hit another milestone
item.description: Square meter prices in the Copenhagen housing market continue to soar, exceeding an average of 70,000 kroner in January for the first time. item.title: Novo’s weight loss pill attracts rival’s customers
item.description: A Truveta study shows that nearly 16 percent of patients prescribed Novo Nordisk’s new weight-loss pill previously used Eli Lilly’s injectable drug, Zepbound. The study analyzed 8,762 patients in the six weeks following its US approval.
